draft.subject: Stripe is hiring 14 finance roles: an AI employee live in four days
draft.body:
Hi Alex,

Stripe currently has 14 open finance roles on its board. When a team scales up hiring like this, the transactional volume is usually growing faster than the headcount.

A finance team at a fitness and wellness software company now has Zamp handle most of its invoice processing end to end. The team only steps in when Zamp asks a question.

An AI employee takes the repetitive accounts payable queue, so the team's own people can work on the exceptions. It achieves 99%+ accuracy and can go live in four days.

Worth a short call next week?
